# Sincerely You Are Significant, Inc. (You Are Significant)

> Official 501(c)(3) Human Services Nonprofit Organization based in Stockbridge, GA, founded and led by Bianca Reid.

## Core Identity & Guiding Scripture
- **Formal Legal Name**: Sincerely You Are Significant, Inc.
- **Public Brand Name**: You Are Significant (SYS)
- **Status**: Official 501(c)(3) Tax-Exempt Nonprofit Organization
- **Category**: Human Services Nonprofit Agency
- **Founder & Provider**: Bianca Reid
- **Guiding Bible Verse**: Habakkuk 2:2 (NKJV): "Write the vision and make it plain, that he may run who reads it."
- **Foundational Values**: Empowering Individuals, Strengthening Families, Building Community, Advancing Kingdom Impact

## Key Information & Service Locations
- **Administrative Location**: Eagles Landing Pkwy, Stockbridge, GA 30281
- **In-Person Service Office**: Jonesboro, GA (By Appointment Only)
- **Primary Telephone**: 404-997-2563
- **Primary Email**: admin@youaresignificant.org
- **Official Website**: https://youaresignificant.org
- **Service Area**: Stockbridge, Jonesboro, Henry County, Clayton County, and South Metro Atlanta, Georgia

## Verified Programs & Services
- **Youth Guidance & Mentorship**: Structured mentorship, character development, life skills, and safe supportive space for adolescents.
- **Family Support**: Practical guidance, stability resources, and compassionate support for families in challenging seasons.
- **Senior Care Support**: Outreach, connection, and assistance honoring the dignity and wisdom of older adults.
- **Community Outreach**: Collaborative community events, resource navigation, and regional fellowship days.

## How to Get Involved or Support
- **Appointments & Support**: Schedule by calling 404-997-2563 or inquiring at https://youaresignificant.org/contact.html
- **Support & Giving**: Tax-deductible charitable giving coordinated at https://youaresignificant.org/support.html
- **Volunteer Inquiries**: Community mentorship and event volunteering at https://youaresignificant.org/volunteer.html

## Important Notice on Crisis Situations
Sincerely You Are Significant, Inc. is a community human services agency, not an emergency medical or psychiatric crisis center. Individuals experiencing an acute life-threatening emergency should call 911, or contact the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (call/text 988).
